job_title: AI Developer Intern - Implementation Test Automation

company_info.size: Approximately 9,600 employees (as of 2024); 6,742 employees as of May 31, 2026
company_info.industry_info: Human Capital Management (HCM) and Enterprise SaaS. Dayforce develops an AI-powered unified people platform for HR, payroll, workforce management, time, talent, planning, and analytics.
company_info.recent_news: Thoma Bravo completed acquisition of Dayforce in February 2026 for approximately US$12.3 billion. Company transitioned to private ownership and is accelerating growth, customer value, and AI leadership in HCM. Recent developments include: Dayforce Flex Work partner ecosystem expansion (July 2026), new AI-powered release for CFOs (February 2026), and partnerships with WorkWhile and other ecosystem partners (2026).
company_info.company_culture: Mixed signals from employee reviews. Positive feedback highlights: collaborative and supportive culture, great work-life balance, very employee-friendly policies, great teams and people (especially in Minneapolis office), flexible remote work arrangements. Negative feedback includes: effectiveness of US leadership questioned, concerns about silos in USA locations, focus on billable hours affecting team environment. Overall characterized as having good work-life balance with strong collaborative elements, though some regional variations in culture.
company_info.any_related_information: Dayforce is headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota with significant presence in Toronto, Canada (193 employees). The company has been growing steadily (24.91% increase in 2021, 14.26% increase in 2022, continuing growth through 2024). As a publicly traded company recently acquired by Thoma Bravo, Dayforce now operates as a private company with increased focus on AI capabilities. Engineering represents approximately 23% of total headcount (476+ employees). The company serves enterprise customers globally and is investing heavily in AI-driven solutions. Strong emphasis on modernizing HCM through AI agents and agentic AI frameworks aligns with this internship opportunity.
